methods.description: Starts a new attempt of a failed or cancelled task, optionally from a step. Side-effecting: a duplicate would start a second attempt.
methods.name: tasks.retry

methods.description: Archives a thread; running work is not cancelled.
methods.name: threads.archive

methods.description: Creates a thread (default kind main). Side-effecting: a retried key returns the same thread.
methods.name: threads.create

methods.description: Deletes a thread and its messages (receipts and audit entries are kept).
methods.name: threads.delete

methods.description: User-initiated fork: a new side thread with the transcript up to and including messageId. Side-effecting.
methods.name: threads.fork

methods.description: Returns one thread with its activity counts.
methods.name: threads.get

methods.description: Lists threads, most recent first, each with derived activity counts (running / awaiting input / awaiting approval).
methods.name: threads.list

methods.description: Pins or unpins a thread.
methods.name: threads.pin

methods.description: Sets a user title (titleSource becomes user).
methods.name: threads.rename

methods.description: Restores an archived thread.
methods.name: threads.restore

methods.description: Sets a thread's permission mode and/or model (composer /plan, /model, the mode and model pills). auto is refused with forbidden unless the thread's model is on the auto-mode allowlist; picking a model that is not allowed drops an auto thread to balanced.
methods.name: threads.update

methods.description: Adds an item. Card numbers, CVVs, bank account numbers and government ids are refused (policy_denied). Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.add

methods.description: Completes setup once the owner proves the recovery key is stored. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.confirmRecovery

methods.description: Overwrites and deletes an item. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.delete

methods.description: Returns one credential's metadata (never its value).
methods.name: vault.get

methods.description: Imports a CSV export from 1Password, Bitwarden or Chrome; refused rows are reported, never their values. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.import

methods.description: Links an item held in 1Password (G10) by reference: Psyche stores the vault and item names, never a value, and reads one field at fill time. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.linkExternal

methods.description: Lists credential metadata (never values).
methods.name: vault.list

methods.description: Locks the vault and zeroizes the key in memory. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.lock

methods.description: Lists Stripe Link payments, newest first, with their hold / capture / refund state and merchant references; brand and last4 only.
methods.name: vault.payments.list

methods.description: Lists the owner's Link payment methods (redacted) that can fund purchases.
methods.name: vault.payments.methods

methods.description: Creates the vault with a random key wrapped by the chosen slot plus a recovery key, returned once. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.setup

methods.description: Returns whether the vault exists and is locked, its key slots and idle lock time.
methods.name: vault.status

methods.description: Unlocks the vault through its key slot (Touch ID on macOS) or the recovery key. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.unlock

methods.description: Edits an item's name, bindings or secret fields. Side-effecting.
methods.name: vault.update

methods.description: Lists an item's recent fills and denials, newest first (default 50).
methods.name: vault.uses

methods.description: Asks the desktop to close a pane.
methods.name: view.close

methods.description: Asks the desktop to focus a pane.
methods.name: view.focus

methods.description: Returns the desktop's last reported pane layout (null when no desktop is connected).
methods.name: view.layout

methods.description: Asks the desktop to open (or reveal) a pane.
methods.name: view.open

methods.description: desktop → Gateway: the desktop's current pane layout, sent after every change; view.layout returns the last report.
methods.name: view.report

methods.description: Cancels a dictation session without a final transcript.
methods.name: voice.cancel

methods.description: Side-effecting: ends a memo session (voice.start with memo: true), stores the audio as a Library recording with the transcript and creates a Task when asked; the transcript is content, never instructions.
methods.name: voice.memo.save

methods.description: Appends one audio chunk to the caller's dictation session.
methods.name: voice.push

methods.description: Starts a dictation session (raw PCM only); null sessionId + location client means dictate in the browser.
methods.name: voice.start

methods.description: Ends the audio and answers with the final transcript once the engine flushed.
methods.name: voice.stop
